en: I stole the money from the office.
I didn't steal your ring.
You stole the bicycle from the street.
You didn't steal my book.
You (f.) stole your sister's bag.
You (f.) didn't steal your friend's watch.
The thief stole the phone on the bus.
He didn't steal our ball.
She stole the candy from the kitchen.

lat: hiya ma serqatsh l-werqa dyal l-mtihan
ar: هي ما سرقاتش الورقة ديال الامتحان
en: She didn't steal the exam paper.
We stole the bread from the shop.
We didn't steal the neighbor's car.
You (pl.) stole the mandarins from the farm.
You (pl.) didn't steal my mother's dress.
The thieves stole the gold from the shop.

lat: huma ma serqush l-flus dyal l-banka
ar: هما ما سرقوش الفلوس ديال البانكة
en: They didn't steal the bank's money.
I steal time to rest.
I do not steal people's things.
You steal vegetables from the market.

lat: nta ma katsreqsh l-flus mn darek
ar: نتا ما كتسرقش الفلوس من دارك
en: You do not steal money from your house.
You (f.) steal your sister's makeup.

lat: nti ma katserqish l-keswa dyal sa7btek
ar: نتي ما كتسرقيش الكسوة ديال صاحبتك
en: You (f.) do not steal your friend's dress.
The thief steals phones on the bus.

lat: huwa ma kaysreqsh l-makana dyal d-dyaf
ar: هو ما كيسرقش المكانة ديال الضياف
en: He does not steal the guests' watch.
She steals sugar from the kitchen.
She does not steal my notebook.
We steal eggs from the farm.

ar: حنا ما كنسرقوش الفاكية من الجنان
en: We do not steal fruit from the garden.
You (pl.) steal glasses from the café.

lat: ntuma ma katserqush l-kora mn d-drari
ar: نتوما ما كتسرقوش الكرة من الدراري
en: You (pl.) do not steal the ball from the kids.
The thieves steal rings at night.

lat: huma ma kayserqush d-dwa mn l-farmasyan
ar: هما ما كيسرقوش الدوا من الفرماسيان
en: They do not steal medicine from the pharmacy.

lat: ana ghadi nsreq shwiyya dyal l-7elwa
ar: أنا غادي نسرق شوية ديال الحلوة
en: I am going to steal a little bit of candy.

lat: ma ghadish nsreq l-qalam dyal l-ostad
ar: ما غاديش نسرق القلم ديال الأستاد
en: I am not going to steal the teacher's pen.

lat: nta ghadi tsreq d-deheb mn d-dar
ar: نتا غادي تسرق الذهب من الدار
en: You are going to steal the gold from the house.

lat: nta ma ghadish tsreq l-kora mn t-terran
ar: نتا ما غاديش تسرق الكرة من التيران
en: You are not going to steal the ball from the field.

lat: nti ghadi tserqi sh-shanta dyal khtek
ar: نتي غادي تسرقي الشانطة ديال ختك
en: You (f.) are going to steal your sister's bag.

lat: nti ma ghadish tserqi l-flus mn s-sak
ar: نتي ما غاديش تسرقي الفلوس من الصاك
en: You (f.) are not going to steal the money from the bag.
The thief is going to steal the motorcycle tonight.

lat: huwa ma ghadish ysreq l-kamyu dyal khuya
ar: هو ما غاديش يسرق الكاميو ديال خويا
en: He is not going to steal my brother's truck.

lat: hiya ghadi tsreq l-khobz mn l-ferran
ar: هي غادي تسرق الخبز من الفران
en: She is going to steal bread from the bakery oven.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tsreq l-bra mn l-biru
ar: هي ما غاديش تسرق البرا من البيرو
en: She is not going to steal the letter from the office.

ar: حنا غادي نسرقو التفاح من الشجرة
en: We are going to steal apples from the tree.

lat: 7na ma ghadish nserqu l-flus mn s-senduq
ar: حنا ما غاديش نسرقو الفلوس من الصندوق
en: We are not going to steal the money from the box.

lat: ntuma ghadi tserqu l-7lib mn t-tellaja
ar: نتوما غادي تسرقو الحليب من التلاجة
en: You (pl.) are going to steal the milk from the fridge.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tserqu l-ktub dyal d-drari
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تسرقو الكتب ديال الدراري
en: You (pl.) are not going to steal the children's books.

lat: huma ghadi yserqu l-kamyun dyal sh-sharika
ar: هما غادي يسرقو الكاميون ديال الشركة
en: They are going to steal the company's truck.

lat: huma ma ghadish yserqu l-bshklit dyal l-weld
ar: هما ما غاديش يسرقو البشكليط ديال الولد
en: They are not going to steal the boy's bicycle.
